confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from two web searches. The Munnar-specific travel-budget figures (for example roughly $1 coffee and $2-11 meals from Budget Your Trip and Champion Traveler) are dated or not clearly dated. Beer and cappuccino figures come mostly from nearby hill towns such as Coonoor and Valparai and from Kottayam, Kerala, with some pages last updated in 2023. Kerala tightly regulates alcohol: beer is usually sold only in licensed bars, beer parlours and hotel bars, at higher prices than proxy-city data suggests. Draft beer is rarely available, so the beer anchor is a bottled-beer-equivalent estimate with an upward adjustment. Direct data for cocktails and wine was weak. Those anchors are based on their typical price relationship to beer in Indian licensed hotel bars, where wine and spirits carry heavy taxes, so they are highly uncertain. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates and do not come from searches or live listings. Munnar has few true hostels, so the dorm and private-hostel figures rely on backpacker homestays and hostel chains in Kerala. Prices for July 2026, during the monsoon low season, may be somewhat below these estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Kerala and Western Ghats hill-station price levels. Proxy data came from Coonoor, Valparai and Kottayam. Munnar prices were adjusted upward for tourist demand, in line with travel-budget data showing Munnar is slightly pricier than typical Indian towns.
